en.commentary:
The ECOVACS WINBOT W3 Omni earns the top spot because it is the only robot here that washes its own cleaning pads mid-run. Win-SLAM 5.0 maps the glass before the first pass even starts, and the 12-level safety system means I trust it on a tenth-floor window the same way I trust it on a ground-floor patio door. That self-cleaning station is the single biggest leap this category has made since dual-ultrasonic spray became standard.

The HOBOT S7 Pro takes second, and it is the one I recommend when streak-free finish matters more than convenience. Its dual-mop system runs 600 strokes per minute, close enough to real hand-wiping that it beats every suction-and-spray robot on this list for pure finish quality, and the square pad design reaches the 90-degree corners every round WINBOT leaves untouched.

The ECOVACS WINBOT W2 Pro Omni holds third as the smartest value play. Its 6-in-1 portable station solves the actual problem that kills most window robot purchases: no outlet near the window. You charge it anywhere in the house and carry the whole station to the glass.

Skip the WINBOT W2S Pro Omni if the W2 Pro Omni already fits your windows. Going fully cordless adds real convenience, but the price jump outpaces the benefit for most living rooms.

The HUTT S7 is the suction champion at 6,500Pa, which matters most once windows have real caked-on grime to cut through. The HOBOT-2S remains the budget benchmark for a reason, basic but it has never once dropped in the reviews I trust. The Mamibot W120-DP earns its spot purely on body thickness, a 2.7-inch profile fits window frames nothing else on this list can enter. The Liectroux YW509 rounds out the list as proof that a $157 robot can still ship with a rated safety rope and real backup power.

highlights.body: Win-SLAM 5.0 navigation and a 12-level safety system back up the self-washing station, the first window robot I'd trust to run unattended on a high floor.

highlights.body: The 6-in-1 portable station charges away from the window entirely, which fixes the single biggest reason apartment buyers give up on window robots.

highlights.body: The strongest grip in this ranking, and the one worth paying for once glass has real caked-on grime to cut through.

zh-tw.commentary:
科沃斯 WINBOT W3 Omni 拿下第一，原因很單純，它是這份清單裡唯一一台能在清潔過程中自己洗布的機種。Win-SLAM 5.0 導航在第一趟擦拭前就先把窗面掃過一輪，再搭配12 級安全防護，我自己會放心讓它在十樓窗戶上跑，跟放在一樓落地窗前面是一樣的心態。這套自動洗布基站，老實說是這個品類自從雙超音波噴霧變成標配之後，最大的一次進化。

HOBOT 玻妞 S7 Pro 排第二，這台是我在意擦完到底有沒有條痕的時候會推薦的機種。雙布振動系統每分鐘來回600 次，已經接近真人手擦的力道，單純比擦拭完成度，贏過這份清單裡所有靠吸力加噴霧的機型，而且方型機身真的能擦到90 度死角，圓形的WINBOT 完全擦不到那個位置。

科沃斯 WINBOT W2 Pro Omni 排第三，是這份清單裡最聰明的性價比選擇。六合一可攜式基站解決的是真正會讓人放棄買擦窗機器人的問題，窗邊沒插座。基站可以在家裡任何地方充電，整組端到窗邊就能用。

如果你家窗戶用W2 Pro Omni 就已經夠用，WINBOT W2S Pro Omni 可以跳過。全無線設計確實方便很多，但多花的價差對大部分客廳來說不太划算。

HUTT S7 吸力是這裡最強的，6500Pa，窗戶已經卡著頑固髒污的時候，這個等級的吸力才真正派上用場。HOBOT-2S 一直是平價機型的標竿是有道理的，功能基本，但我信任的那幾篇評測裡它沒出過包。Mamibot W120-DP 純靠機身厚度拿到這個位置，2.7 吋薄機身可以塞進這份清單其他機型進不去的窄框。Liectroux YW509 排在清單最後，但它證明了一台157 美元的機器人一樣可以配安全繩跟真正的斷電備援。

highlights.body: Win-SLAM 5.0 導航加12 級安全防護撐著這套自洗基站，是我第一台敢放著不管、讓它在高樓層自己跑完全程的擦窗機器人。

en.commentary: Nothing material has changed since yesterday's launch entry, so the ranking holds exactly where it started. The WINBOT W3 Omni keeps the top spot for the same reason I gave it the lead in the first place, it's the only robot in this category that washes its own cleaning pads mid-run, and that self-cleaning station is the single biggest functional leap this category has made since dual-ultrasonic spray became standard a few years back. The HOBOT S7 Pro holds second on the strongest pure cleaning score here at 9.6, its 600 strokes per minute dual-mop system still produces the closest finish to real hand-wiping I've seen in a robot, which matters most for anyone who cares about zero-streak glass over raw convenience. The WINBOT W2 Pro Omni rounds out the top three as the smartest value pick, a 9.0 value score, the highest among the WINBOT lineup, comes from getting most of the W3's navigation and safety performance at a meaningfully lower price. I'm giving this list another few days before making any real adjustments, a single day with no new reviews or price movement isn't enough signal to shift anyone's rank, and I'd rather keep this fledgling ranking stable while more comparison data comes in than chase noise this early.

en.commentary: Nothing material changed since the last entry, so the ranking holds exactly where it started. The WINBOT W3 Omni keeps the top spot for the reason I gave it the lead in the first place, it is the only robot in this category that washes its own cleaning pads mid-run through its Vortex Wash system, which is why its safety score reaches 9.7 and its cleaning score reaches 9.5, numbers that come from not dragging an increasingly dirty pad across the same window for an entire cycle. Hobot's S7 Pro holds second on a 9.6 cleaning score that actually edges the W3 Omni, but its 8.8 navigation score trails the Ecovacs flagship enough to keep it one spot back. The W2 Pro Omni earns rank 3 on a 9.0 value score that makes it the practical pick inside Ecovacs's own lineup for buyers who do not need every feature the flagship carries. At the budget end, Mamibot's W120-DP and Liectroux's YW509 both lean on value scores above 8.3 while trailing on cleaning and navigation, an honest tradeoff for a smaller window collection that does not justify flagship pricing. ECOVACS used this year's IFA show to preview its next generation of cleaning robots broadly, but nothing specific enough to score has actually reached this category yet, so today is for watching, with nothing new to rank yet.

highlights.body: A 9.5 cleaning score and 9.7 safety score both trace back to a mid-run pad-washing system that prevents the robot from dragging an increasingly dirty pad across glass for an entire cycle.

highlights.title: Hobot's S7 Pro Actually Beats the W3 Omni on Raw Cleaning
highlights.body: A 9.6 cleaning score edges past the Ecovacs flagship, but an 8.8 navigation score keeps it one rank back, proof that cleaning power alone does not decide the top spot.

highlights.title: The W2 Pro Omni Is the Practical Pick Inside Ecovacs's Own Lineup
highlights.body: A 9.0 value score, the best among Ecovacs models here, makes it the sensible choice for buyers who do not need every feature the flagship W3 Omni carries.

highlights.title: Budget Picks Trade Cleaning Power for Value, Not the Other Way Around
highlights.body: Mamibot and Liectroux both lean on value scores above 8.3 while trailing on cleaning and navigation, a fair tradeoff aimed at a small window collection, not a full house of floor-to-ceiling glass.
